description_en: Modifies an IP Address Management (IPAM) instance
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam update-ipam --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-id ipam-ccxbnsbhew0d6t0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIpam

parameters.help_en: The ID of the hosted region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to get the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPAM托管地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPAM
parameters.name: ipam_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPAM. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM的名称。

长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipam_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the IPAM. The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. If you do not specify this parameter, the description is empty.

It must be 1 to 256 characters in length and start with a letter or a Chinese character, but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The default value is empty
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM的描述信息。


长度为1～256个字符，必须以英文大小写字母或中文开头。但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。默认为空，不填则为空
parameters.name: ipam_description

parameters.help_en: The list of operating regions to add to the IPAM
parameters.help_zh: 为IPAM添加的生效地域列表
parameters.name: add_operating_region

parameters.help_en: The list of operating regions to remove from the IPAM
parameters.help_zh: 为IPAM移除的生效地域列表
parameters.name: remove_operating_region

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): Sends the request. If the request passes the check, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the IPAM instance is modified
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改IPAM实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并修改IPAM实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID for each request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
